title: Outrageously Garlicky Mexican Beef Tacos
description: A garlicky, pillowy, midnight-craving Mexican dish featuring sesame seed burger buns and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients, steamed to perfection with mushimono-steam method.
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the sliced onion to the skillet and cook until it is translucent.
Mince the garlic and add it to the skillet, cooking for an additional minute.
Stir in the cumin, chili powder, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the water to the skillet and bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Split the sesame seed burger buns in half and toast until lightly browned.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the beef mixture onto the toasted buns.
Serve immediately, garnished with any desired toppings.
